label: Caption - Parallax Layers
description: Caption rendered as stacked depth layers (back, mid, front) that enter and drift at different speeds for a parallax 3D-depth feel.

primary.label: Back Layer Color
primary.description: Color of the deepest layer (maps to --mp-color-primary).

accent.label: Mid Layer Color
accent.description: Color of the middle layer (maps to --mp-color-accent).
